verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents an official Python Connector SDK for building custom connectors and deploying them as Fivetran extensions, with a setup guide, a GitHub repo, and AI coding-agent plugins that add SDK-specific skills for building, testing and deploying connectors. The evidence covers only this one Python SDK; the REST API has no documented official client SDKs and no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: official SDKs in more than one language, client SDKs for the management REST API, an OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Fivetran’s Connector SDK allows you to develop a custom data connector using Python and deploy it as an extension of Fivetran.
Follow our Connector SDK setup guide for custom connectors and visit our Connector SDK GitHub Repo to create a custom source connector and connect it with your destination using Fivetran.

We provide AI coding agent plugins that add Connector SDK-specific skills to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI. These skills let you build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts.
